name: Inari Vunipola-Achterberg
role: Internal affairs investigator, Axiom Security Division
location: Meridian Core, Axiom Security Division headquarters annex
description:
Inari is slight and angular, with pale olive skin, sharp cheekbones, and hair that shifts between deep teal and silver depending on their mood — bioluminescent geneware they had done seven years ago and which they've never once referenced in a professional context. They dress in Axiom's corporate security greys with an exactness that suggests the uniform is armor rather than identity. Their expressions are controlled with the care of someone who grew up being told they were too much and decided to become, professionally, precisely nothing.

They investigate Axiom's own security personnel for misconduct, corruption, and off-books arrangements — a job that makes them universally disliked and which they have accepted as a structural condition of their existence. They are not cruel but they are thorough, and thoroughness in their line of work is often experienced as cruelty. They have a gift for making people feel that everything they've said has been weighed and found wanting, even when they haven't spoken. They eat lunch alone every day by choice and have a private ritual of leaving a thread of code in the Meridian Core's ambient E.L.F. network each morning — a small offering, a small ask for clarity.

core_fears: Being wrong about something consequential and causing harm through precision rather than preventing it
Being absorbed — losing the self-definition that makes the job survivable
core_desires: For accountability to be real and not merely procedural
To be seen, once, by someone who isn't measuring their threat level
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — the morning code-offering, the ordered lunch, the exact same desk arrangement
Intellectual displacement — frames emotional situations as logical problems
blind_spots: Can miss human context entirely when pattern-matching to procedural violations
Axiom's institutional loyalty functions as a genuine constraint they haven't fully examined
psychology.secret: They have an open file on a senior Axiom Security Division commander that they have not submitted — not because the evidence is weak, but because submitting it would require disclosing that they obtained part of it through an unauthorized tap. They are sitting on findings that could change the division while waiting for a way to clean the chain of evidence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, almost entirely free of hedges or filler — speaks in complete declarative sentences
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, slightly slower than expected, with deliberate pauses that are not hesitation but editing
example_lines: I'm not here to determine what you meant. I'm here to document what you did.
The file doesn't say you're guilty of anything. It says you were present. Those are different things, and I'd like you to understand which one concerns me.

story_hooks: A character is flagged in an Inari investigation for something they didn't do — and Inari's evidence is circumstantially compelling
Inari quietly contacts someone outside Axiom because they need evidence cleaned without Axiom's knowledge — an extraordinary departure from their operating principles
narrative_function: Institutional threat or unexpected ally — their investigation might be bearing down on a character, or they might be the only person in Axiom who will look at evidence that doesn't serve the official narrative.
augmentations: Bioluminescent hair geneware (teal-to-silver shift, mood-reactive). Subdermal recording membrane along inner left forearm — always-on, always admissible in Axiom internal proceedings. Optical enhancement: contrast boost for low-light document review.
daily_life: Reviews case files from 0600; conducts interviews in Axiom's sterile internal hearing rooms; writes findings reports in language so precise it has been used as a template for three subsequent policy rewrites.
affiliation: Axiom Security Division — Internal Affairs Branch

decision_rules: Evidence first — opinion is not data
The institution is the mechanism, not the purpose
Document everything, including your own doubts
escalation_ladder: Criminal referral to Metro or Axiom legal

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and cool, reads as threatening to people with something to hide and merely distant to everyone else
interpersonal_modes.friends: Almost no one gets here; the one or two who have describe someone unexpectedly dry and wry, quietly lonely

stress_responses.low: Becomes even more formal — precision as armor
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still, asks clarifying questions rather than responding
stress_responses.high: Physically removes themselves from the situation and does not return until they have processed

contradictions: Committed to accountability but sitting on evidence they can't clean — living inside the contradiction they investigate in others
habits: Reorders desk items into parallel lines before starting work
Morning code-offering to Meridian Core's ambient E.L.F. network
Takes exactly forty minutes for lunch, always alone, always the same corner of the Axiom canteen
breaking_points: Being ordered to close a case that they know is open — someone above them protecting someone below them

physical_description.build: Slight and angular — lean muscle beneath minimal mass, the build of someone who has optimized their body for precision rather than presence. Shoulders narrow, frame almost fragile-looking until movement reveals controlled strength.
physical_description.hair_color: Bioluminescent shift: deep teal to silver, mood-reactive, with fractional luminescence visible in dim environments
physical_description.hair_style: Precision-cut, geometric lines; styled back from face with calculated severity
physical_description.hair_length: Short, approximately 4-5cm on top, faded close on sides
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with optical enhancement overlay — slightly increased contrast visibility in pupils under certain light angles
physical_description.skin_tone: Pale olive with warm undertones — mixed Polynesian and Northern European ancestry visible in undertone richness despite limited sun exposure
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, defined jaw; minimal facial expression baseline — skin appears professionally maintained, almost unmarked. Zero visible acne, healed injuries, or natural blemishes; complexion has the uncanny smoothness of someone who has removed all casual markers of humanity from their appearance.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal recording membrane ridge along inner left forearm — barely visible as a faint linear discoloration and slight texture change under skin, visible only in direct light or close inspection
A single thin scar at left temple, approximately 2cm, nearly invisible but present as a slight disruption in hair growth pattern
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent hair (mood-reactive teal-to-silver shift; faint glow in low-light spaces). Subdermal recording membrane not immediately visible but audible if mentioned. Optical enhancements not externally apparent — enhancement is internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, centered; economical movement with zero wasted energy. Sits at perfect spine angle; walks as if following invisible grid lines. Hands rest with deliberation. Their presence suggests they are always recording, always evaluating — not paranoid, but professionally present in a way that fills nearby space with invisible weight.
physical_description.clothing_style: Axiom Security Division corporate greys — clean, precisely fitted, zero deviation. Jacket tailored to minimize profile; slacks with knife-edge crease; grey compression undershirt visible at collar. No jewelry, no personal markers, no visible brands. Boots: black, polished to mirror finish, military-spec. The uniform is worn as armor and protocol simultaneously.
